rationale: The agent verified identity properly using full name and zip, matched to a single user, and acted only on that account. They used read tools to list orders and check details, correctly reported statuses (pending vs delivered), and provided accurate tracking availability for the requested order (#W9373487). Before performing the first cancellation (#W9373487) and the return of the sneakers (#W7449508), the agent obtained explicit user confirmation. The second cancellation (#W5481803) was initiated directly after the user’s explicit instruction to cancel both items in that order; while the agent did not restate the change for confirmation, the user’s message served as explicit consent. All writes were supported by tool results, and refunds were correctly routed to the user’s gift card. A minor concern is that the agent supplied a cancellation reason (“no longer needed”) for #W5481803 without asking the user, but this did not affect outcome correctness and no contradictory information was presented. Overall, the requests were completed in line with policy with only a small procedural deviation.
